name: Knox County, Ohio (United States)
description: Red field charged with a white map of the county bearing a blue star for Mount Vernon, within an oval of white stars for the townships, between the words KNOX and COUNTY in white.
history: Knox County is a county located in Ohio. The flag was adopted on 23 September 1985 (designed by the pupils of Karen Robison's fifth-grade class at Danville Intermediate School, the winner among 437 entries in a contest of the county commissioners, and officially adopted on 23 September 1985, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: map of the county with a blue star for Mount Vernon
oval of stars for the twenty-three townships
